summary: Master customer experience governance and service standards with practical tools, KPI dashboards, and complaint handling methods. Enrol now.
lede: Customer experience governance defines service rules, control points and measures for consistent customer-facing operations. Designed for professionals in customer operations, quality assurance, service recovery or CX reporting, the course develops practical skills in setting service commitments, analysing complaint trends and mapping escalation workflows. Participants also practise building service performance scorecards and closed-loop follow-up routines to monitor adherence and guide service improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in customer-facing operations, quality assurance, service recovery, or CX reporting and need a stronger governance model. Customer Experience Managers responsible for governance structures and service standards. Service Quality Leads tracking adherence to customer-facing operating rules. Customer Operations Supervisors managing escalations and quality checks. Contact Centre Managers overseeing service consistency and complaint handling. Complaint Handling Specialists documenting resolution patterns and root causes. CX Analysts building dashboards from feedback, SLA, and case data. Service Level Managers monitoring commitments across channels and teams. Customer Success Managers aligning support practices with service expectations. Quality Assurance Analysts sampling cases against service standards. Business Process Improvement Leads redesigning service workflows and controls.
modules: CX Governance Controls and Quality Assurance
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, basic spreadsheet skills, and sample service data if available. Prior experience in customer service, CX operations, quality assurance, or complaint handling will help you apply the exercises faster.
